name: Roland RD-2000
description: Roland RD-2000 stage piano: the temporary Program (common, song/rhythm, delay, reverb, an internal and an external zone for each of zones 1-8, and a Modulation FX and Tremolo/Amp Simulator for zones 1-4) and the system blocks (common, compressor), from the MIDI Implementation.

sources.title: RD-2000 MIDI Implementation (version 1.01, Jan. 1, 2018)
sources.notes: Parameter Address Map read by tools/profiles/roland/parse-address-map.mjs from RD-2000_MIDI_Imple_eng02_W.pdf (sha256 38ff8e76be717fb3109a7d4831c0fa1efe9f591a8075b77f2a0b02e5a1a477fd). Model ID 00 00 75, DT1 = 12, RQ1 = 11, Roland checksum. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is the manual's, at the manual's address, with the manual's name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

One identity for the RD-2000 and the RD-2000EX: both reply family 75 02, number 00 01 (p8 of each manual), the RD-2000 with revision 00 01 00 00 and the RD-2000EX with 01 01 00 00. Profiles do not pin the revision, so choosing either profile for the other is not flagged; the two maps are the same.

Zones are filed as zone1 … zone8, each with .internal (Program Internal Zone) and .external (Program External Zone); zones 1-4 also have .modFx (Program Modulation FX) and .tremoloAmp (Program Tremolo/Amp Simulator), laid out from the one table the manual prints for both (p12). The map gives zones 5-8 no effects pair.

The Internal Zone table (p12-13) prints Hammer Noise, Damper Noise, String Resonance and Key Off Resonance twice: once in the group from Nuance to Hum Noise (00 32-00 3A) and again in the group from Instruments Number to Key Off Noise (06 66-06 70); Hammer Noise is 62-66 both times, the other three 0-127 the first time and 0-10 the second. They are numbered in printed order (hammerNoise1 at 00 33, hammerNoise2 at 06 6A, and so on); the manual heads neither group.

Program Common's Tone Color, Modulation FX and Tremolo/Amp Control Destination (00 5E-00 60, p10) are printed with the labels UPPER1, UPPER2, UPPER3, LOWER, which are the RD-800's layer names; this map's parts are Zones 1-8. The labels are kept as printed.

The worked RQ1 (p16) prints F0 41 10 00 00 75 10 00 00 00 00 00 01 44 2B F7 for Program Common: the address, size and checksum are this profile's requestProgram, but the 11H command byte is missing from both the diagram and the summary line.
The worked examples call the Program's delay address "the address of DELAY TYPE of Setup" (p16); there is no Setup block in this map.

Program Common 00 63-00 7E (p10-11) is a group the manual opens with a rule and Sympathetic Resonance Switch and does not otherwise head: Depth, Damper, Pre LPF … Level, Damper Offset … Damper Min Pkg. Their ids are the printed names (program.depth, program.damper, program.level), which in this block mean the resonance's, not the program's.

coverage.inboundControllers: not modelled: what the front panel and the external zones transmit (Control Change, p6-7) is not mapped yet
coverage.effectParameterMeanings: type-dependent: Delay, Reverb, Modulation FX and Tremolo/Amp Simulator parameters are Roland's 4-nibble container (12768-52768, shown -20000..+20000); what each slot does depends on the selected type, which the MIDI Implementation does not list
coverage.presets: none: the MIDI Implementation prints no Bank Select table for live sets or programs, only the generic Bank Select and Program Change messages ("1. Receive data", p1-3), so no bank list is claimed
coverage.memories: not in the map: the MIDI Implementation prints only the system and the temporary area; stored live sets/programs have no addresses there
